title: Totally '90s
intro: [excited] Grab your scrunchie and rewind your VHS tapes, because today is Totally Nineties! Films, Disney Afternoon cartoons, Disney Channel movies and parks from the decade that gave us everything. [laughs] As if!

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A 1990s kid bedroom: chunky tube television glowing, stacked clamshell video cases, a neon inflatable chair, glow-in-the-dark stars on the ceiling, bright geometric wallpaper.

categories.title: Live-Action Throwbacks
categories.intro: Our film category: Live-Action Throwbacks, the non-animated Disney movies we watched over and over in the nineties.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A 1990s video store shelf of blank clamshell cases, a hockey stick, a witch broom and a bobsled leaning against the counter.

clues.clue: Three witch sisters come back to Salem on Halloween night in this 1993 movie.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Hocus Pocus! [laughs] Amok, amok, amok! It became a huge hit years later on TV.

clues.clue: This 1993 comedy is inspired by Jamaica's real bobsled team at the 1988 Winter Olympics.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Cool Runnings! [excited] Feel the rhythm, feel the rhyme. Get on up, it's bobsled time!

clues.clue: Emilio Estevez coaches a pee-wee hockey team in this 1992 film.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is The Mighty Ducks! Quack, quack, quack! Disney even named a real NHL team after it.

clues.clue: In 1998's The Parent Trap, the twins first meet at this summer camp.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Camp Walden! [laughs] One fencing match, one secret handshake, and two parents who never saw it coming.

clues.clue: In Homeward Bound, Michael J. Fox voices this goofy young American bulldog.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Chance! [chuckles] Sally Field is Sassy the cat and Don Ameche is wise old Shadow.

categories.title: Weekday Afternoons
categories.intro: [excited] Drop your backpack and grab a snack! This category is about The Disney Afternoon cartoons.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A cosy 1990s living room after school, a backpack tossed on the carpet, a juice box and snack on a tray in front of a glowing TV, afternoon sunlight.

clues.clue: Huey, Dewey and Louie go treasure hunting with Uncle Scrooge in this cartoon. Woo-oo!
clues.reveal: The correct answer is DuckTales! [excited] Life is like a hurricane here in Duckburg.

clues.clue: In this series, Baloo the bear flies a cargo seaplane called the Sea Duck.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is TaleSpin! [laughs] Baloo as a pilot, Louie as a club owner, and Shere Khan as a business tycoon.

clues.clue: Gadget, Monterey Jack and Zipper team up with two chipmunks in this series.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Chip 'n Dale: Rescue Rangers! Monterey Jack gets wobbly at the smell of cheese. [laughs] Relatable.

clues.clue: Darkwing Duck protects this city. Let's get dangerous!
clues.reveal: The correct answer is St. Canard! [excited] I am the terror that flaps in the night!

clues.clue: In this 1993 series, a cartoon bobcat becomes a police officer in Hollywood.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Bonkers! [laughs] A Toon cop who bounced through The Disney Afternoon for a season.

categories.title: Pass the Props
categories.intro: Picture time! Each image is full of props from one nineties Disney animated film. Name the movie.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A dusty attic prop table covered in mysterious objects: a brass lamp, a rose under glass, a bronze bell, an ornate comb and a teacup, warm spotlight.

clues.clue: Which 1990s animated movie do these props come from?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Aladdin! [excited] Rub the lamp, get three wishes. Just don't wish for more wishes.

media.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A battered golden oil lamp glowing on a pile of gold coins in a vast cave of treasure, a red jewel and a flying patterned rug in the background.

clues.clue: Which 1990s animated movie do these props come from?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Beauty and the Beast! [whispers] Last petal falls, and that's it. No pressure.

media.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A single glowing red rose floating under a glass bell jar on a table in a dark castle wing, a hand mirror beside it and petals scattered on the wood.

clues.clue: Which 1990s animated movie do these props come from?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is The Hunchback of Notre Dame! [chuckles] Bells, stone gargoyles and a hand-carved model of Paris.

media.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. Inside a gothic cathedral bell tower high above Paris, enormous bronze bells, three stone gargoyles on a ledge and a tiny hand-carved wooden model of a medieval town.

clues.clue: Which 1990s animated movie do these props come from?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Mulan! A lucky cricket in a cage, a comb from her father and a sword. [excited] Let's get down to business!

media.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A small bamboo cricket cage, an ornate hair comb and a sword resting on folded armour beneath a blossoming plum tree, a stone dragon statue in the background.

clues.clue: Which 1990s animated movie do these props come from?
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Tarzan! [laughs] A Victorian tea set in a jungle treehouse, plus a sketchbook full of gorillas. You'll be in my heart.

categories.title: Rad Rides of the '90s
categories.intro: [excited] Let's hop over to the parks, where the nineties gave us brand new parks, brand new drops and one very scary alien.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A theme park at dusk in 1990s style, a towering haunted hotel struck by lightning, a log flume splash and a neon-lit futuristic land.

clues.clue: The Disney park that opened outside Paris in 1992 is in this country.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is France! [laughs] It opened as Euro Disney. Today it's Disneyland Paris.

clues.clue: Disney's Animal Kingdom opened on Earth Day of this year.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is 1998! It opened on April 22nd, Earth Day. Nahtazu, as they say. Not a zoo.

clues.clue: The Twilight Zone Tower of Terror first dropped riders at Disney-MGM Studios in this year.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is 1994! [gasps] It opened in July, and people are still screaming.

clues.clue: This log flume opened at Magic Kingdom in 1992 and closed in 2023 to become Tiana's Bayou Adventure.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Splash Mountain! [excited] A five-story drop into the briar patch, now home to Tiana.

clues.clue: Magic Kingdom's scary Tomorrowland show from 1995 had an alien loose in the dark. It was called ExtraTERRORestrial this.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Alien Encounter! [whispers] It was so scary that Stitch's Great Escape took over the building in 2004.

categories.title: Original Movie Marathon
categories.intro: Our wildcard is a nineties Disney Channel Original Movie marathon. Pajamas are optional.

art.prompt: Original painterly digital illustration, 16:9, cinematic lighting, rich saturated colour, no people, no characters, no logos, no text or lettering. A sleepover living room with sleeping bags, popcorn bowls, a futuristic house with glowing windows on a TV and inline skates by the couch.

clues.clue: Debbie Reynolds plays a witch grandma who brings her grandkids to a magical town in this 1998 movie.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Halloweentown! [laughs] Grandma Aggie is the coolest grandma ever.

clues.clue: In this 1999 movie, a family's computer-run house, PAT, gets way too protective.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Smart House! [chuckles] PAT starts out making smoothies and ends up locking everyone in.

clues.clue: This 1999 teen heroine lives on a space station in the year 2049. Zetus lapetus!
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Zenon: Girl of the 21st Century! [excited] Zoom zoom zoom, make my heart go boom boom!

clues.clue: This 1998 movie is about a crew of inline skaters called the Soul Skaters.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Brink! [laughs] Skating for fun versus skating for money. Very nineties.

clues.clue: In this 1999 movie, a teen surfer from Hawaii moves to Vermont and takes up snowboarding.
clues.reveal: The correct answer is Johnny Tsunami! [chuckles] Big waves become big snow. Tough trade.
